about: The deviations allow-list of E 9 (Headspace, phase 1). A new difference is either an engine bug or a new entry added by Opus, never by an implementing task. Regions are in SKIN px; a rect is half-open [x0,x1) x [y0,y1) (the EQ ear's closed and open rects union to (0,86)-(476,256), so the end is exclusive). A bound is the most skin px the entry may absorb: a number, null (measure mode: report and pass; check --strict fails) or "rect-area" (the rect's own area). exact means the count must equal the bound and the region's size. Computed regions come from regions.mjs (art-derived at run time, so no art coordinates live here) except faithful-xor-compat, which cmd-check derives from the two engine configurations' masks.

entries.why: the visualizer is stubbed differently on each side: head.bmp's #FF00FF pixels at the head's offset are not compared

the engine follows the docs (BUTTONGROUP pixels no mappingColor owns are not painted); the oracle paints them. Measured at G4: spec 6.5 predicts about 811 in the transport group and 1 in min/close. Bound set at G4 from the measured count (812 in S1, S2, S4 at DPR 1)
the engine puts the reset label at eq1.top + 83 = 127; the oracle at 129

the anti-aliased end pixel of the reset underline is #a5b39c in the engine and #a5b39b in the oracle (blue, one unit). The text box and the background pixel under it are identical, and the node's own HTML renders either value depending on the page; what differs is the surface under the pixel: the engine's keyed bitmaps are elements, which Chromium composites as their own layers, so the compositor blends the text over them, while the oracle's shares the text's layer and the rasteriser blends it. A 1x1 repro (the same underlined text over a div or against a ) flips the value. Compat only: in faithful, D20-reset-y holds the pixel. Added by 5F.1 under its card's second clause; stale if a Chromium or surface change makes it match
the engine uses the 10 pt default (13 px) for the preset title; the oracle 9 px

sliderGeometry is 'oracle' in both configurations, so nothing may be absorbed; the entry exists so flipping the switch comes with its region (the region lists the sliders whose position is literal in the .wms: it is advisory while the bound is 0, because any pixel it would absorb fails against the bound or lies outside every region)
the oracle counts the effects canvas as a solid rect, so its mask has the screen's 106 clipped corner bits that the engine's does not

a BUTTON receives clicks on its transparent keyed pixels; the oracle's alpha mask does not. Defined at check time as faithfulMask XOR compatMask; measured at G4 (a judge measured 130 EQ handle + 135 PL handle, about 265 per state). Bound set at G4 from the measured count (265 in S1, S2, S4 at DPR 1)

at DPR 2 the oracle's #viz mask (vid_bkgd.png) is filtered with image-rendering: auto (style.css:48-50, 130-133) and bleeds about one device pixel into the screen's top-left corner, where head.bmp is the red clipping colour; the engine clips those pixels by D26 and cannot paint them. Measured 23 px at DPR 2, 0 at DPR 1
the same oracle mask bleed at the screen's top-right corner. Measured 16 px at DPR 2, 0 at DPR 1

the oracle sets image-rendering: pixelated only on img and canvas (style.css), so its slider .track border-image is filtered bilinear at DPR 2; the engine draws tracks crisp per E D2. Ruled at G5: the engine keeps the crisp tracks (no compat smoothing switch). Measured 6,670 px at DPR 2 across the 12 EQ-drawer tracks, 0 at DPR 1

the playlist combo's 12x12 CD icon (an SVG data-URI img) rasterises a few edge pixels differently in the engine's windowed widget layer than in the legacy combo; 9 px at DPR 1, 10 at DPR 2. Root cause not proven (likely the 5F.1 compositing class); allowed under the owner's working-first policy with a tight bound
